course_name: 產業發展與文化資產專題
outline:
本課程探討產業發展歷程中，產業文化資產的出現、保存與再利用等課題。
透過文獻研讀、議題討論、國內外個案研討、實地參訪、參與學術研討會、作業報告等方式。
This course introduces the issues of the appearance, preservation, and reuse of industrial Cultural Heritage in the process of industrial development. Through the literature study, discussion topics, domestic and foreign case studies, field visits, participation in academic seminars, job reports, etc.,
schedule:
Week 1:     Class Introduction (prepare for paper publishing)
Week 2:     Understanding the definition of Creative Industry (including Cultural Heritage)
Week 3:     The Development of Creative Industry (including Cultural Heritage)
Week 4:     Why the Creative Industry Matter to Economic Evolution?
Week 5:     Review Unit

Week 6:     The Paradigm Shift from Cultural Industry to Cultural Creative Industry (Value Chain )
Week 7:     The Paradigm Shift from Cultural Industry to Cultural Creative Industry (Organizational Units, and Creative Management)
Week 8	Management and Creativity: How to manage Creative Deviants
Week 9	Management and Creativity: The Balance of Creativity and Rationality
Week 10	Review Unit

Week 11	Cultural Heritage Marketing Strategy
Week 12	Cultural Heritage Recreation Development
Week 13	How to Apply Cultural Heritage Intellectual Property
Week 14	Site Visit: NPM

Week 15	Group Presentation for NPM tour
Week 16	Planned Published Case Study (Real case)
Week 17	Discussion on published paper (Theory-based)
Week 18	Final Exam
